title: 超市购物
goal: 会在超市找东西、问价格和保质期，结账时听懂收银员的问题。
tips: 找东西：Where can I find ...? / Which aisle is the ... in?（……在哪一排货架？）
收银员常问：Do you have a membership card?（有会员卡吗）Do you need a bag?（要袋子吗）
buy one get one free = 买一送一；on sale = 打折中；expiration date = 保质期到期日。

exchanges.hear: Can I help you find something?
exchanges.reply: Yes, where can I find the rice?

exchanges.hear: The milk is in aisle seven, next to the eggs.
exchanges.hearZh: 牛奶在第七排，鸡蛋旁边。

exchanges.hear: Do you have a membership card?
exchanges.reply: No, I don't. Can I get one?

exchanges.hear: These apples are buy one get one free.
exchanges.reply: Great, I'll take two bags then.

exchanges.hear: Excuse me, this yogurt is out of date.
exchanges.hearZh: 打扰一下，这个酸奶过期了。
exchanges.reply: Oh, sorry. I'll get you a new one.
exchanges.replyZh: 哦，抱歉，我给您换一盒新的。

exchanges.hear: The self-checkout is not working. Please use the counter.
exchanges.hearZh: 自助结账机坏了，请到柜台结账。
exchanges.reply: OK. Which line is the shortest?
Can I pay with my phone?

lines.en: Excuse me. Where can I find olive oil?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，橄榄油在哪儿？

lines.en: It's in aisle four, on the top shelf.
Thanks. And do you have any fresh fish today?
lines.zh: 谢谢。今天有新鲜的鱼吗？

lines.en: Yes, at the seafood counter in the back.
Great. Are these strawberries on sale?
lines.zh: 好的。这些草莓在打折吗？

lines.en: Yes, they're buy one get one free this week.
Let me check. The date is on the back. Next Tuesday.
lines.zh: 我看看，日期在背面。下周二。
